copy.blurb: FIFA World Cup 2026 pits Canada against Bosnia and Herzegovina. Our Elo prior, after host and altitude adjustments where they apply, rates Bosnia and Herzegovina to win at 34%. Polymarket prices the same outcome at 22% — implying a model-versus-market gap of +11.1 percentage points. That clears our 3pp threshold, so the verdict reads Pick. Calibration history sits with the closing market across recent fixtures; selection is the dimension this Pick is meant to add value on.
copy.summary: The model rates Bosnia and Herzegovina at 34%; the market prices that side at 22%. The +11.1pp gap is the basis for the Pick.
